text:
tom_sales: Heads-up: customer (global payroll) asking about Private Deploy POC. They're strict on IP allowlists and need a signed security checklist. They want PrivateLink + optional TGW peering, cross-AZ HA, BYOIP not possible on their side. Also require monthly IP rotation and proof of audit logs. Can someone create a short handoff and include firewall snippets and a security checklist?

ana_neteng: quick: PrivateLink interface endpoints NAT outbound so client src IP not preserved. Ways to preserve identity: 1) client inserts X-Forwarded-For via internal proxy; 2) PROXY protocol to pass original IP; 3) set up a NAT in their VPC with static EIP we see (but they said BYOIP not possible). If they can't BYOIP, best is PROXY protocol or XFF.

charlie_arch: Cross-AZ: create one endpoint per AZ and HA proxy autoscale. For cross-region either replicate endpoints or TGW. If peering/TGW is used, we can accept routed traffic but we need advertised prefixes and BGP session details. For private DNS, enable aws privatelink DNS so service FQDN resolves to ENI IPs.

nina_security: Security checklist (short):
- Confirm KMS for audit logs + retention window and access controls.
- Confirm TLS expectations: SNI passthrough preferred; if they terminate TLS at proxy, we require mTLS to Redwood or a cert pinning arrangement.
- Agree on EIP rotation cadence and maintenance windows; any rotation must be communicated 72h prior for firewall rule updates.

ana_neteng: firewall snippet (egress):
```
# allow outbound to Redwood POC
allow tcp from 172.20.0.0/16 to 18.205.10.99/32 443
# allow to interface endpoint security groups
allow tcp from 172.20.0.0/16 to sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f 443
# Optional healthchecks
allow tcp from 172.20.0.0/16 <- 15.61.100.0/24 443
```
Replace placeholders with POC ticket values.

charlie_arch: Cost note for salesperson: PrivateLink easier for short tests; per-endpoint and per-GB processing apply. TGW/peering reduces per-endpoint fees but may have transit costs. If they need predictable low-latency, endpoints are simplest. For monthly EIP rotation, if they cannot provide automation, it adds ops overhead (we bill time).

ticket_bot: ticket-bot: Created POC-12021-net-handoff, assigned to #eng-oncall, owner: ana_neteng, ETA: 3 business days.

charlie_arch: 3-line netops handoff to paste: 
- Provision PrivateLink interface endpoints in each AZ; configure privatelink DNS and HA proxies.
- Note: interface endpoints NAT client IP; to preserve original IP use PROXY protocol from their egress proxy or have client add X-Forwarded-For header.
- Open outbound TCP/443 to assigned EIP(s) or vpce IDs; provide expected monthly egress (GB) to estimate cost.

tom_sales: Thanks — I'll add their network diagram and timeline to POC-12021.
